lexi: Hey design — launch creative ask: social cards, webinar deck master, and two benchmark diagrams. Need final assets by Wed EOD. Can you confirm scope?

craig: We can take this. Need exact sizes, copy lock, and tracking params.

kate: Copy (final):
- Headline: "Redwood Inference — predictable LLM serving"
- Subhead: "One API. Hosted, Dedicated, Private. Lower latency, predictable cost."
- CTA: "Register: redwood.ai/launch?utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_source=social"

craig: Tracking for growth: utm_medium={platform}, utm_source=social, utm_campaign=launch_q2. Add ?src=paid for ads.

lexi: Deliverables list: 1200x628, 1080x1080, 1920x1080 hero; LinkedIn carousel (3x 1080); webinar .pptx + Figma master; two benchmark diagrams (clean + annotated) in light/dark; exported PNG/SVG + alt text sheet.

craig: Naming convention: redwood_launch_{asset}_{size}_{theme}.png — and include a small README with UTM JSON snippet.

kate: Accessibility: AA contrast, alt text drafts, and color contrast screenshots please.

craig: We'll recreate benchmark charts from the CSVs as vector graphics in Figma and keep data identical. Link to raw data: internal drive.

design-bot: Task created: ASANA-4890 "Launch visuals + webinar deck" assigned @craig, due 2026-03-25. :white_check_mark:

lexi: Two bonus asks: add a one-slide cost vs latency visual for marketing and an engineer checklist slide (SDK links, supported runtimes).

craig: Noted. Thumbnails Monday AM, full draft Tue, final Wed EOD. Flag immediately if blocked.

kate: EN-only for this sprint. We'll localize later if needed.

lexi: Thanks team, looking forward to thumbnails.
